appraisal_events.evidence: elle me les sacrifia aisément, à ma grande satisfaction, car j'attachais beaucoup d'importance à avoir avec moi une jeune ménagère qui saurait bien mieux commander le dîner que moi ... Il est certain qu'elle avait représenté tout autre chose pour moi, à Balbec ... des liens sociaux qui survivent à notre amour et même au souvenir de notre amour.
appraisal_events.explanation: Now absorbed in desire for Mme de Stermaria, the narrator summons Albertine merely to help plan another woman's dinner; she readily gives up her own plans for him, and he explicitly notes she has been reduced from the Balbec passion she once represented to a convenient social tie outlasting his love for her.

status_effects.explanation: Once the object of the narrator's Balbec passion and jealousy, she is now cast as a convenient companion he calls on to help arrange another woman's dinner, sacrificing her own plans for him with no reciprocal regard on his part.
He holds the emotional upper hand, indifferent to appearing unshaven before her and freely redirecting her time to serve his pursuit of Mme de Stermaria.
